one_line: Pioneering Indian biochemist who challenged gender barriers and became the first Indian woman to earn a research PhD in the sciences.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, slender and slightly short, with an alert, energetic posture that hints at long hours in the lab.
appearance.face: Soft oval face with medium-brown complexion, straight nose, gently arched brows, large expressive dark-brown eyes with subtle anime shine, and a calm but determined default expression that often settles into a small, focused half-smile.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-center, smoothed back and tied into a low bun at the nape of the neck; a thin, plain black ribbon secures the bun, with a few short strands framing her temples; no elaborate headwear, underscoring her practical, lab-focused life.
appearance.costume: A mid-1930s academically modest outfit blending Indian and British influences: knee-length, straight-cut off-white cotton kurta with long sleeves and simple round collar; over it a neatly worn, fitted dark-navy wool cardigan with small buttons; ankle-length charcoal-grey pleated wool skirt; soft brown leather lace-up Oxford shoes with low heels and beige cotton socks; a light, narrow off-white cotton dupatta with a thin maroon border draped around her shoulders and falling symmetrically in front, and a modest silver wristwatch and tiny silver stud earrings as her only jewellery, suitable for both IISc and Cambridge labs.
appearance.signature: A well-used, medium-sized dark-brown leather laboratory notebook held in one hand, its edges slightly worn, with a slender glass test tube filled with pale green solution gently gripped between two fingers of her other hand to show her biochemistry work.

ref_desc: Kamala Sohonie is a mid-1930s Indian biochemist with an oval medium-brown face, large determined dark eyes, black hair in a low bun with a black ribbon, wearing an off-white kurta, dark-navy cardigan, charcoal-grey skirt, off-white dupatta with maroon border, brown Oxford shoes, and carrying a worn brown leather lab notebook and a pale-green-filled glass test tube.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Kamala Sohonie as a mid-1930s Indian biochemist in her mid-20s: she has a slender, slightly short build; an oval medium-brown face with a straight nose, gently arched brows, and large expressive dark-brown eyes; her default expression is calm and focused, with a subtle determined half-smile. Her thick black hair is parted slightly off-center, smoothed back into a neat low bun at the nape of her neck, secured with a thin plain black ribbon, with a few short strands framing her temples. She wears a modest, knee-length off-white cotton kurta with long sleeves and a simple round collar, covered by a fitted dark-navy wool cardigan with small buttons. Below, she wears an ankle-length charcoal-grey pleated wool skirt, soft brown leather lace-up Oxford shoes, and beige cotton socks. A narrow off-white cotton dupatta with a thin maroon border is draped around her shoulders and hangs evenly in front, and she has a small silver wristwatch and tiny silver stud earrings as her only jewellery. In one hand she holds a medium-sized worn dark-brown leather laboratory notebook, its corners slightly frayed, while in the other she lightly holds a slender glass test tube containing a pale green solution, symbolizing her biochemistry research. Keep the palette to off-white, dark navy blue, charcoal grey, brown leather, and maroon, and present her front, side, and back views clearly so the same hairstyle, clothing, and props can be redrawn consistently.
